items.question: What products does FEELEXIM export?
items.answer: FEELEXIM focuses on Indian-origin agricultural products including whole spices (cumin, coriander, turmeric, black pepper, fennel, fenugreek, mustard, cloves), spice powders (turmeric, red chilli, coriander, ginger, garlic, onion), seeds (sesame, flax, chia, basil, kalonji, quinoa), and selected nuts and agricultural commodities. We are also open to sourcing other Indian-origin products based on buyer requirements.

items.question: Can I request product samples?
items.answer: Sample coordination is possible for many products and is subject to product availability, agreed terms, and destination-specific requirements. Please contact us through the enquiry form to discuss your sample needs, and we will do our best to accommodate your request.

items.question: Can packaging be customised?
items.answer: Yes, we are open to discussing flexible packaging options — including private label, custom sizes, and specific packaging materials — subject to minimum order quantities and mutually agreed commercial terms. Please share your packaging requirements through the enquiry form.

items.question: Can you coordinate export documentation?
items.answer: We provide support for export documentation coordination, including commercial invoices, packing lists, phytosanitary certificates, certificates of origin, and other documents that may be required for your destination market. Specific documentation depends on the product, destination country, and applicable regulations.

items.question: How can I request a quotation?
items.answer: You can request a quotation by filling out the enquiry form on our Contact page or by reaching out directly via email or phone. Please include the product name, estimated quantity, preferred packaging, and destination port so we can provide an accurate quotation.

items.question: Do you accept product-specific sourcing requests?
items.answer: Yes. If you are looking for a specific Indian-origin agricultural product not listed in our catalog, please contact us with your requirements. We will assess the sourcing feasibility and revert with available options.

contactCta.heading: Let’s Start a Conversation.
contactCta.description: Share your target commodity specifications, required volume (FCL or LCL), and destination port. Our export desk will revert within 24 business hours.

meta.title: About Us
meta.description: Learn about FEELEXIM, our values, and our mission connecting international importers with authentic Indian spices, seeds, and agricultural commodities.

about.description: FEELEXIM operates as an international trade and sourcing house headquartered in India, coordinating high-grade spices, seeds, nuts, and agricultural products for international buyers.
about.paragraph1: India produces some of the world’s most sought-after agricultural commodities — from pungent cumin and vibrant high-curcumin turmeric to pure sesame and medicinal seeds. However, navigating regional suppliers, fluctuating moisture standards, and complex export paperwork can pose major challenges for global importers.
about.paragraph2: FEELEXIM was founded to eliminate this friction. We serve as your dedicated Indian sourcing arm — identifying authentic supplies, arranging independent laboratory tests, supervising sorting and custom packaging, and securing statutory export certifications before container dispatch.
about.complianceNote: All export shipments undergo required statutory phytosanitary inspections and quality checks in full compliance with Indian trade authorities.

certifications.name: FSSAI
certifications.fullName: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
certifications.purpose: Apex food safety regulatory licensing ensuring purity, sanitary processing, and absence of prohibited adulterants.

certifications.purpose: Statutory certificate permitting legitimate commercial export of whole spices and spice powders from India.

certifications.purpose: Permanent business identification code issued by the Directorate General of Foreign Trade for cross-border shipments.

certifications.purpose: Registration governing export standards, packaging requirements, and promotion of Indian agricultural produce.

quality.note: * Note: In accordance with our authenticity commitment, only verified registrations held by FEELEXIM are listed above.
quality.protocolsSubtitle: Every shipment follows a structured quality verification workflow.

protocols.title: Moisture Control
protocols.desc: Each commodity is dried and sorted to maintain moisture strictly beneath statutory thresholds (typically 8% - 10%), inhibiting fungal growth and microbial spoilage during marine transit.

protocols.title: Sortex Cleaning & Optical Grading
protocols.desc: Color sortex grading machines eliminate discolored seeds, stones, and foreign matter to achieve clean purities from 99.0% up to 99.9% as demanded by buyers.

protocols.title: Pesticide & Chemical Residue Testing
protocols.desc: Samples can be submitted to NABL accredited laboratories (e.g. SGS, Eurofins, Geo-Chem) to verify compliance with destination MRLs (Maximum Residue Limits).

protocols.title: Phytosanitary & Fumigation Protocol
protocols.desc: Mandatory methyl bromide or aluminum phosphide fumigation of containers combined with official government phytosanitary inspection certificates prior to loading.

quality.ctaDescription: We are accustomed to aligning packaging and laboratory protocols to meet regional import regulations worldwide.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lastUpdated: Last Updated: October 2026 • FEELEXIM Compliance Team

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
paragraphs: When you submit a quotation inquiry or contact request on the {name} website, we collect personal and commercial information including your name, company name, corporate email address, phone/WhatsApp number, destination country, and specified commodity requirements.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: The information collected is used exclusively for legitimate business communication:
list: Preparing and sending formal export price quotations (FOB/CIF/CFR).
Coordinating commodity sample deliveries and laboratory testing reports.
Facilitating container freight, customs documentation, and commercial agreements.

sections.title: 3. Data Protection & Confidentiality
paragraphs: We do not sell, rent, or trade your contact or business information with third-party advertising networks. Information is only shared with authorized statutory trade authorities, shipping carriers, and inspection agencies strictly necessary to execute your export order.

sections.title: 4. Contacting Us
paragraphs: For any questions regarding your data or this policy, contact our privacy desk at {email}.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.lastUpdated: Last Updated: October 2026 • FEELEXIM Trade Operations

sections.title: 1. Quotations & Price Validity
paragraphs: Commodity market prices for agricultural crops, spices, and seeds are subject to daily market fluctuations, crop arrival volumes, and currency variations. Quotations issued through the {name} platform or direct correspondence are valid only for the validity duration explicitly stated on the written proforma or quote sheet.

sections.title: 2. Quality Specifications & Tolerances
paragraphs: All shipments are executed in compliance with contractual specifications agreed between buyer and seller. Standard agricultural tolerances (moisture, foreign matter, admixture, broken grains) follow RCMC / APEDA / AGMARK guidelines unless custom tolerances are contractually defined.

sections.title: 3. International Commercial Terms (Incoterms)
paragraphs: Standard contracts are governed by ICC Incoterms (typically FOB Indian Ports, CIF, or CFR Destination Ports). Marine insurance, customs handling, and discharge demurrage are assigned according to the agreed Incoterm in each individual contract.

sections.title: 4. Force Majeure
paragraphs: Neither party shall be held liable for delays or failure in delivery resulting from acts of God, extreme adverse weather conditions, freight embargoes, government export restrictions, or unforeseen international shipping disruptions beyond reasonable control.

sections.title: 5. Governing Law & Dispute Resolution
paragraphs: All trade contracts and commercial agreements are subject to the laws and jurisdiction of India, with mutual arbitration conducted under standard rules of international spice and commodity trade associations where applicable.
